svg.title: Dependency — direct vector trace of xkcd 2347
svg.desc: Vector trace refined by fitting the original manually authored Bézier paths and per-path stroke widths to the 2x source. No raster image or substitute font is embedded. Original direct trace preserved in dependency-manual.svg.
svg.metadata: Source: https://imgs.xkcd.com/comics/dependency_2x.png. Direct manually authored coordinate trace preserved in dependency-manual.svg; this version fits Bézier controls and per-path widths to the 2x source. No raster image, substitute font, or pixel contour extraction. Cubic subdivisions preserve fine hand-drawn irregularities.
